The repository has a validated ChangePermit chain and durable Host/LangGraph resume mechanics, but no runtime adapter translates that existing permit into the dispatcher WriteAuthorityGuard protocol and no concrete HumanGateAdapter persists and validates an exact gate-bound decision artifact.

repair_governance already validates one active permit and exact allowed/forbidden paths.
concrete_host_bootstrap currently injects None instead of adapting that existing authority.
LangGraph and TaskRun preserve HUMAN_GATE waits, while the concrete factory injects no gate adapter.
Therefore the initialized Host is read-only and cannot execute a real human decision boundary.

Let capability activation, Host selection, CONFIRM, CI green, or Quality green grant mutation authority.
Treat a generic write permit as pull-request merge authority.
Accept an inline Human Gate answer without exact durable decision evidence.
Create another TaskRun, completion, release, merge, or production controller.
